name: VMS Event Bridge — Manual Trigger + VAPIX Event
description: Trigger from the Event Engine UI (Fire Now button) or the REST API to instantly emit a VAPIX event that your VMS (e.g. AXIS Camera Station, Milestone) is subscribed to — allowing Event Engine rules to initiate VMS actions. Also accepts an HTTP webhook as a trigger so any external system can initiate the bridge. Demonstrates the manual trigger, http_webhook trigger, and fire_vapix_event action.
